guard: the web dashboard demands TLS when its mesh record requires it, so it refuses a plaintext broker substituted on the recorded port
why: The web cell ran without the web extension installed, so `cotal web` was an unknown command and its refusal, which printed the command list, satisfied the reason check through the word "down". The cell now installs the extension in its sandbox. Dropping the client's own TLS requirement must redden it, since the substitute broker would then be accepted.
The suite installs web from implementations/web, which ships its build, so the mutation builds the package first and the restore rebuilds it.

mutations.name: web no longer demands the TLS its mesh record requires
